maria (PM): Quick check-in: pilots require a clear burst commitment for GA. Two asks: 2x short bursts (10m) and transparent billing. Need a recommended default by EOD tomorrow.
kevin (Eng): Two quick patterns: (1) Hard burst band per tenant (preallocated, premium SKU) — simple to reason about. (2) Credit-based soft burst with carryover + preemption of best-effort tasks — cheaper but more infra + billing work.
alex (SRE): Ops tradeoffs: hard band = easier enforcement and predictable evictions. Credit model needs fast accounting and can cause multi-tenant spill if many use it simultaneously. We need clear spillover rules either way.
sasha (ML): For embedding-heavy customers we can offer a quantized variant during burst windows to reduce footprint ~25% — opt-in. Will run quality checks if we greenlight.
jen (Sales): Customers prefer predictability for GA. They'll pay a premium for hard band. Credit model is appealing for SMBs later. Also request a UI toggle to preview burst cost before enabling.
maria (PM): Proposed GA path: ship hard burst band (option 1) for pilots, run credit model experiment in parallel for SMBs. Action items: kevin prototype reserve config + sim (EOD), alex draft spillover runbook (tomorrow), sasha start quant eval (48h), jen confirm pilot willingness (today).
deploy-bot: Ticket created RDW-7011 "GA burst commitment + billing" -> https://tracker.example/RDW-7011 :robot_face:
kevin (Eng): Kicking off sim: ./tools/sim_burst --tenants pilotA,pilotB --pattern 2x-10m --out s3://rdw/rtc/1767778888.log
maria (PM): Thanks all — we'll reconvene tomorrow 11am to lock decision.
